rows.note: Use 酸 as the all-purpose noun for a chemical acid.

example.english: This acid releases hydrogen ions when dissolved in water.
example.traditional: 呢種酸溶喺水入面會釋放氫離子。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 syun1 jung4 hai2 seoi2 jap6 min6 wui5 sik1 fong3 hing1 lei4 zi2

rows.note: Use 酸嘢 for sour stuff or a sour substance, especially in a food context.

example.english: This sour stuff has so much acid that it makes me pucker.
example.traditional: 呢碟酸嘢酸到我皺晒眉。
example.jyutping: ni1 dip6 syun1 je5 syun1 dou3 ngo5 zau3 saai3 mei4
